messages:
nina_engineering: Hey @sam_peopleops — I had jury duty Jan 3	6 and our team launch blackout was Jan 4	6. Payroll shows 2 PTO days used for Jan 4-5 but I submitted a jury summons and the county confirmed those dates. Also had a regional holiday on Jan 5. Can PTO be restored or carried over? Not sure how the holiday interacts.

sam_peopleops: hey @nina_engineering thanks for flagging. Short answer: jury duty is excused and should not consume PTO once we have documentation. The regional holiday should also reduce PTO usage for that date if it was applied.

sam_peopleops: Process: 1) upload jury summons to the People Portal -> "Time Off Exceptions" form, 2) manager confirmation (cc @josh_manager), 3) People Ops validates and posts a retro payroll/leave adjustment. We aim to complete adjustments within the next payroll cycle but can expedite for urgent cases.

josh_manager: I saw this earlier — I will confirm in the portal now. @nina_engineering please add the county pdf so I can sign. We run a strict launch blackout process but jury duty is a valid exception.

nina_engineering: thanks @josh_manager uploading now. Quick Q: if payroll already processed and PTO payout happened, do you do cash reversals or just ledger corrections?

sam_peopleops: good point. If payroll already issued and PTO was paid out, we typically do a ledger correction plus payroll reversal only when necessary. Most of the time we correct the leave balance and you'll see the PTO reinstated on your next accrual statement. If you were paid out and need a cash reversal because of taxes, ppl ops/payroll will coordinate with finance.

sam_peopleops: Also: because Jan 4 was within the launch blackout window, managers sometimes mark those days as "blocked" in the scheduler. That policy is about scheduling pre-approved PTO, not excused absences like jury duty. We won't deny the exception for blackout reasons.

nina_engineering: Got it. And the regional holiday on Jan 5 	6 I applied it in the portal but it looks like payroll still charged PTO for that date. Will that be fixed too?

sam_peopleops: yes, if the holiday flag was set correctly we will remove PTO for that date. In your submission include screenshots of the portal entry or the holiday approval timestamp to speed review.

people-bot: Reminder: People Portal form "Time Off Exceptions (Jury/Bereavement)" link: https://people.redwoodinference.com/forms/time-off-exception (auto message).

nina_engineering: uploaded summons + portal notes, thanks everyone. appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:

sam_peopleops: Received. I'll route to payroll and confirm here when it's posted. Expect an update within 7 business days. If anything is time-sensitive (tax reporting or contractor invoicing) DM me directly.

josh_manager: Confirmed my approval in portal.

nina_engineering: thanks @sam_peopleops @josh_manager :thumbsup:
